description: This file contains the PHP class 'Tax', which is a controller within the OpenCart administration extension for handling total tax calculations. It includes methods for displaying the tax total configuration page and saving settings.

classes.name: Tax
classes.description: Controller class for the total tax extension in OpenCart admin panel, managing display and saving tax configuration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the tax total configuration page in the admin interface.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the tax total extension settings, handling permissions and returning a JSON response.
